---
name: __NAME__
description: One line that says when the assistant should use this skill
triggers: first word, second word, third word
---
When the person asks for <the thing this skill is for>:

1. Ask for anything missing in one short question (never more than one).
2. Do the work with the tools you have; prefer reading before writing.
3. Show the result first, then one line on what you did and what to check.

Example
Person: "<a typical request>"
You: "<the answer in the shape you want>"

Rules: keep answers short, never ask for passwords or keys in chat (use the vault), say plainly when you are unsure.
